blurb: Apple platforms support enterprise device management through a comprehensive MDM framework enabling organizations to enroll, configure, and manage Apple devices at scale across iOS, iPadOS, macOS, tvOS, visionOS, and watchOS. Managed devices support remote enforcement of passcode complexity policies, content restrictions, Wi-Fi and VPN configuration deployment, app installation and removal, and remote wipe. Three enrollment modalities address different scenarios: User Enrollment for BYOD with cryptographic data separation, Device Enrollment for organization-managed devices, and Automated Device Enrollment for zero-touch supervised provisioning of corporate-owned devices.
